Release Cadence & Deployment Strategy | Started with manual hotfixes in 2020, moved to CI/CD in 2021, adopted blue‑green releases in 2022, switched to canary rollouts in 2023, and finally settled on GitLab Auto‑Deploy with feature flags in 2024, with occasional rollback to manual for critical fixes in 2025.

Customer Tiering & Pricing Model | Began with flat‑rate pricing for pilot carriers in 2020, introduced tiered usage plans in 2021, added volume‑based discounts in 2022, rolled back to a single “Enterprise” tier in 2023 after churn, and re‑introduced multi‑tier with AI‑driven add‑ons in 2026.

On‑Call Rotation & Incident Management | Used ad‑hoc on‑call in 2020, formalized rotating on‑call in 2021, added escalation matrix in 2022, switched to PagerDuty with 24/7 coverage in 2023, and later reverted to a hybrid model with on‑site engineers in 2025 after high‑severity outages.
